glossEn: a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction
note: a tangible symbol signifying approval or distinction。线索：win / receive an award。强调是**实物**；award ceremony/prize 是抽象的「奖项」。

glossEn: a grant made by a law court
note: a grant made by a law court。线索：an award of damages / the court awarded。法律义，与 s1 分界在是否由法院作出。

glossEn: give, especially as an honor or reward / give as judged due or on the basis of merit
note: give, especially as an honor or reward / give as judged due。动词义。线索：award sb sth / be awarded a grant。
